title: Integration by parts for Jacobian minors of Lipschitz maps (formula (∗) for Lipschitz maps)
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, g_0, …, g_r : ℝᵏ → ℝ L-Lipschitz, V_0, …, V_r ∈ ℝᵏ and ψ : ℝᵏ → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support (ℝᵏ = Euclid k with Lebesgue measure; D = fderiv ℝ, the zero map at non-differentiability points). Let A(x) := (Dg_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin(r+1)} and M_b(x) := det(Dg_{c+1}(x)V_{s_b(b')})_{c,b' ∈ Fin r} with s_b = Fin.succAbove b. Then ∫ ψ(x)·det A(x) dx = −Σ_{b=0}^{r} (−1)^b ∫ Dψ(x)V_b·g_0(x)·M_b(x) dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (g : Fin (r + 1) → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin (r + 1) → Euclid k) (ψ : Euclid k → ℝ), (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ x, ψ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b)) = -∑ b : Fin (r + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (b : ℕ) * ∫ x, fderiv ℝ ψ x (V b) * g 0 x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun (c b' : Fin r) => fderiv ℝ (g c.succ) x (V (b.succAbove b')))
